items.title: Sunday Pick: Do all my friends secretly …
items.source: TED Talks · Daily · 个人学习用
sentences: Why does making friends as an adult feel like mission impossible?
In today’s Sunday Pick, Corner Piece , host Melissa Fernandes explores what it means to be a friend while grappling with a friendship break up.
Along the way, she interviews Anna Goldfarb, journalist and author of “Modern Friendship: How to Nurture Our Most Valuable Connections,” and Dr.
Franco, professor and author of “Platonic: How the Science of Attachment Can Help You Make—And Keep—Friends”.
They explain why friendship can get so complicated as you get older and how to build closer bonds.
Melissa also explores with her co-hosts Taha Khan and Sabrina Cruz what their different types of friendships mean to them.
